newsitem.title: CANADA: Conpak Seafoods to buy Daley Bros fishing.
newsitem.headline: Conpak Seafoods to buy Daley Bros fishing.

text.p: Conpak Seafoods Inc said on Monday it has reached an agreement and executed a letter of intent to acquire all of the fishing related assets from Daley Brothers Ltd for C$21 million.
Conpak said it will purchase the assets with a combination of common and preferred shares. It said the deal is subject to regulatory approval and is expected to close in mid-summer.

"The addition of Daley Brothers assets and management team to our company (Conpak) will significantly increase our effectiveness and ability to compete in this industry," said Percy McDonald, President of Conpak.
Conpak said the combined companies are expected to generate revenues in excess of $50 million annually.
Conpak also said that its board of directors appointed Terry Daley to the position of Chief Executive Officer, but Percy McDonald will remain as President.
